camel_example: aliyun arms GetManagedPrometheusStatus --region cn-hangzhou --ClusterId cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClusterType ask
description_en: Queries the installation status of a Prometheus agent in a serverless Kubernetes (ASK) cluster or an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) cluster
description_zh: 获取托管版（ask、ecs和one）Prometheus实例的安装状态
kebab_example: aliyun arms get-managed-prometheus-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id cc7a37ee31aea4ed1a059eff8034b0000 --cluster-type ask --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetManagedPrometheusStatus

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. This parameter is required if the ClusterType parameter is set to ask
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The resource group id of the Prometheus instance
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the cluster. Valid values: ask and ecs
parameters.help_zh: 集群类型。目前支持ask、acs、ecs和one实例
parameters.name: cluster_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC). This parameter is required if the ClusterType parameter is set to ecs
parameters.name: vpc_id

Data.description_en:
The installation status of the Prometheus agent.

Installing: The Prometheus agent is installed and no registration information is available.
Succeed: The Prometheus agent is installed and registered.
Failure: The Prometheus agent failed to be installed or registered.
Unknown: The installation status of the Prometheus agent is unknown
Data.description_zh:
查询状态结果。
Installing：install成功且无Agent注册信息。
Succeed：install成功且Agent注册成功。
Failure：install失败或Agent注册失败。
Unknown： 无install状态

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

`true`
`false`
Success.description_zh:
是否操作成功。

`true`删除成功
`false`删除失败
